profile.title: Professional Information
profile.bio:
Full Stack developer based in Mérida. I work with Java and Spring Boot on the backend, Angular on the frontend, Flutter for mobile and Python with FastAPI for internal services and automation.

Higher Technician in Multiplatform Application Development (DAM) with Honor Distinction. I'm currently taking a specialization in Artificial Intelligence and Big Data and, on my own, learning game development with Godot Engine and GDScript.

Here you will find my web, mobile, backend and data projects, each with its source code on GitHub.

project1.title: The Witcher Web
project1.summary: A simple browser game inspired by The Witcher universe, featuring a small gameplay loop, sprite-style graphics and basic state management. Developed as an educational project.

project2.title: Portfolio
project2.summary: A Windows XP-style personal portfolio showcasing projects, skills and resume, with multilingual support and subtle visual details.

project3.title: Eventvs Mérida
project3.summary: Landing page for the Eventvs Mérida application, developed as a Final Degree Project.

projects.spotify: Android application inspired by Spotify, featuring registration, login, songs, playlists and profile. Integrates Firebase, Supabase Storage and the Deezer API. Developed as an educational project.
projects.eventvs: Mobile application for discovering leisure and cultural activities in Mérida, featuring events, map, calendar and sections of interest. Final Degree Project.

commandPrompt.title: Data, AI & Services
commandPrompt.hint: Click a project to read its README.

linkChecker.description: Internal service for an online store that periodically checks that product links still work and reports the broken ones.

features.scheduled: Automatic, periodic check of every product link.
features.history: Stores the HTTP code, whether the link is broken and the date of the last check.
features.onDemand: On-demand checks and an API documented with Swagger.

clickReports.description: Internal service for an online store that records product clicks and turns them into simple statistics.

features.register: Endpoint to record clicks on each product.
features.stats: Total clicks per product and clicks per day, with an optional product filter.
features.csv: CSV report export built with Pandas.

steamGames.description: Big Data analysis of the Steam games released between 2020 and 2025 to decide which genre and category a game studio should develop.

features.dataset: Custom dataset of about 81,000 games, downloaded from the Steam API.
features.questions: Success versus competition by genre, how supply evolved, pricing and multiplayer.
